name: Egg Toast
description: Crispy golden bread topped with savory spiced onion scrambled eggs — ready in 10 minutes.
steps: Finely dice the onion and whisk together with eggs and a pinch of salt.
Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat and toast the bread slices until crisp and golden.
Pour the egg-onion mixture into the pan and cook gently, folding until soft and set.
Spoon the warm scrambled eggs onto the toasted bread and serve immediately.

substitutions.egg: Mashed chickpea batter (besan chilla mix) or crumbled paneer
substitutions.onion: Spring onion, shallots, or a pinch of garlic powder
substitutions.bread: Tortilla wrap, roti, or English muffin

name: Tomato Egg Stir-Fry
description: Silky scrambled eggs folded into a sweet-savory blistered tomato sauce.
steps: Cut tomatoes into wedges and beat eggs with a pinch of salt.
Scramble eggs softly in 1 tbsp oil until just set, then transfer to a plate.
Saute minced garlic and tomato wedges in remaining oil until juicy and saucy.
Fold eggs back into the tomatoes, garnish with spring onion, and serve warm.

substitutions.tomato: Canned diced tomatoes or 2 tbsp tomato paste + splash of water
substitutions.garlic: 1/4 tsp garlic powder or sliced onion
substitutions.spring onion: Fresh coriander or chopped regular onion

name: Garlic Butter Pasta
description: Pantry-staple pasta tossed in fragrant golden garlic butter and melted cheese.
steps: Boil pasta in salted water until al dente, reserving 1/2 cup of pasta water.
Melt butter over low heat and gently sizzle thinly sliced garlic and chopped chili.
Toss drained pasta into the garlic butter with a splash of reserved pasta water.
Stir in grated cheese until glossy and creamy, then serve.

substitutions.pasta: Instant noodles (discard seasoning packet) or cooked rice
substitutions.cheese: Nutritional yeast or a splash of milk + flour
substitutions.chili: Black pepper or red chili flakes

name: Vegetable Fried Rice
description: Fast wok-tossed leftover rice with crisp diced vegetables, egg, and umami soy glaze.
steps: Dice carrot, onion, and garlic finely; break up cold leftover rice with your fingers.
Scramble beaten eggs in hot oil, push to the side, and stir-fry garlic, onion, and carrot for 3 minutes.
Add rice over high heat and toss for 3–4 minutes until grains toast lightly.
Drizzle soy sauce around the edges of the pan, toss well, and serve.

substitutions.rice: Quinoa, couscous, or chopped leftover chapati
substitutions.egg: Diced tofu, paneer, or extra peas
substitutions.soy sauce: Pinch of salt + splash of vinegar or Worcestershire sauce

name: Cheesy Tomato Grilled Sandwich
description: Crisp skillet-toasted sandwich oozing with melted cheese, juicy tomato, and sweet onion.
steps: Slice tomato and onion thinly; butter the outer sides of all bread slices.
Layer cheese, tomato, a pinch of salt, and onion between two slices of bread.
Toast in a skillet over medium-low heat for 3 minutes per side until golden and melted.
Slice diagonally and serve hot.

name: Aloo Jeera (Cumin Potatoes)
description: Golden pan-roasted potato cubes tempered with crackling cumin seeds and warm turmeric.
steps: Peel and dice potatoes into bite-sized cubes (parboil 5 minutes for faster cooking).
Heat oil in a pan and splutter cumin seeds and chopped green chili.
Add potatoes, turmeric, and salt; toss well and cook covered for 10–12 minutes until tender and crisp-edged.
Finish with chopped coriander and serve with bread or rice.

substitutions.turmeric: Curry powder or pinch of paprika
substitutions.coriander: Spring onion greens or dried parsley

name: Spanish Potato Omelette
description: Thick, hearty tortilla española packed with tender pan-cooked potatoes and sweet onions.
steps: Thinly slice peeled potatoes and onion; cook gently in oil over medium-low heat until soft (12 minutes).
Beat eggs with salt in a bowl and fold in the warm drained potatoes and onions.
Pour mixture back into the skillet and cook on low heat for 5 minutes until edges set.
Invert onto a plate, slide back in to brown the other side for 3 minutes, and slice into wedges.

substitutions.egg: Chickpea flour batter mixed with water and baking powder

name: Quick Chickpea Masala
description: Hearty protein-packed chickpeas simmered in a rich spiced onion-tomato gravy.
steps: Saute finely chopped onion and garlic in oil until golden brown.
Stir in cumin, turmeric, chopped tomatoes, and salt; cook until tomatoes break down into a paste.
Add drained chickpeas and 1/2 cup water; simmer 10 minutes, mashing a few chickpeas to thicken.
Serve hot with rice, toast, or flatbread.

substitutions.chickpeas: Kidney beans, black beans, or boiled potatoes

name: Shakshuka Skillet Eggs
description: Eggs poached directly in a fragrant, smoky spiced tomato and bell pepper sauce.
steps: Saute diced onion, bell pepper, and garlic in oil until softened.
Add chopped tomatoes, cumin, and salt; simmer 8 minutes until thick and saucy.
Make four wells in the sauce and crack an egg into each well.
Cover and cook 5–6 minutes until egg whites set while yolks stay runny.

substitutions.egg: Feta cheese cubes or drained chickpeas

name: Classic Dal Tadka
description: Comforting yellow lentils simmered with turmeric and finished with sizzling garlic-cumin tempering.
steps: Rinse dal and simmer in water with turmeric and salt for 18 minutes until soft and creamy.
In a small pan, heat oil and sizzle cumin seeds, sliced garlic, and diced onion until golden.
Add chopped tomato and cook 3 minutes until soft.
Pour the sizzling tadka over the cooked dal, stir gently, and serve with rice or bread.

substitutions.tomato: Squeeze of lemon juice at the end

name: Banana Oat Pancakes
description: Naturally sweet 4-ingredient blender or mash-bowl pancakes made from ripe bananas and oats.
steps: Mash ripe bananas smoothly in a bowl (or blend all ingredients together).
Whisk in eggs, oats, milk, and a tiny pinch of salt; rest batter 3 minutes to thicken.
Cook small ladlefuls in a lightly buttered pan over medium-low heat for 2 minutes per side.
Serve warm topped with extra banana slices or honey.

substitutions.oats: Whole wheat flour or all-purpose flour

name: Creamy Spinach & Garlic Pasta
description: Velvety one-pan garlic-cheese sauce studded with wilted fresh spinach leaves.
steps: Cook pasta in salted water until al dente and drain.
Saute minced garlic in butter for 1 minute, then add spinach and wilt for 2 minutes.
Pour in milk and simmer gently; whisk in grated cheese until smooth.
Toss cooked pasta in the creamy green sauce and serve immediately.

substitutions.spinach: Frozen peas, broccoli florets, or kale
substitutions.milk: Cream, evaporated milk, or starchy pasta water

name: Bean & Cheese Quesadilla
description: Crispy toasted tortilla stuffed with smashed seasoned beans, diced veggies, and gooey cheese.
steps: Lightly mash drained beans with a fork and season with a pinch of salt.
Spread beans, diced onion, diced tomato, and cheese over half of each tortilla and fold over.
Toast in a lightly oiled skillet over medium heat for 2–3 minutes per side until crisp and melted.
Cut into wedges and serve.

substitutions.tortilla: Chapati, roti, or two slices of bread

name: Lemon Garlic Herb Chicken
description: Juicy pan-seared chicken breast glazed in a bright, savory lemon-garlic pan sauce.
steps: Slice chicken into thin cutlets and season both sides with salt.
Sear in hot oil for 4–5 minutes per side until golden and cooked through.
Lower heat, add butter and minced garlic for 1 minute, then squeeze in fresh lemon juice.
Spoon the glossy pan sauce over the chicken and serve.

substitutions.chicken: Firm tofu steaks or paneer slices
substitutions.lemon: 1 tbsp white vinegar or lime juice

name: Egg Fried Noodles
description: Street-style wok-tossed noodles with crunchy shredded cabbage, carrots, egg, and soy sauce.
steps: Boil noodles/spaghetti in salted water until tender, drain, and toss with a drop of oil.
Scramble eggs in a hot pan, remove, then stir-fry garlic, shredded cabbage, and julienned carrot for 2 minutes.
Add noodles, cooked eggs, and soy sauce; toss vigorously over high heat for 2 minutes.
Serve piping hot.

substitutions.soy sauce: Salt + pinch of sugar + splash of vinegar

name: Curd Rice (Thayir Sadam)
description: Cooling South Indian comfort bowl of mashed soft rice, creamy yogurt, crunchy veggies, and cumin tempering.
steps: Mash warm or room-temperature cooked rice lightly with a spoon.
Fold in yogurt, salt, finely diced cucumber, and grated carrot until creamy.
Heat oil in a small spoon or pan, crackle cumin seeds, and pour over the curd rice.
Stir gently and serve chilled or at room temperature.

substitutions.cucumber: Pomegranate seeds or finely diced apple

name: Crispy Potato Rosti
description: Golden, lacy shredded potato hash cake with crisp edges and a tender center.
steps: Grate peeled potatoes and onion; squeeze firmly in a clean towel to remove excess moisture.
Toss shredded mixture with salt.
Press evenly into a skillet with hot oil and butter; cook 7 minutes per side until deeply golden and crisp.
Cut into wedges and serve hot.

name: Masala Omelette
description: Fluffy spiced Indian-style omelette loaded with crunchy onions, tomatoes, green chili, and herbs.
steps: Whisk eggs with turmeric and salt until frothy.
Stir in finely diced onion, tomato, green chili, and chopped coriander.
Pour into a hot greased skillet and cook 2 minutes until bottom sets; flip and cook 1 minute more.
Serve hot with buttered toast.

name: Garlic & Herb Bruschetta
description: Crunchy garlic-rubbed toast piled high with fresh marinated diced tomatoes and herbs.
steps: Dice tomatoes finely and toss with chopped herbs, 1 tbsp oil, and salt.
Toast bread slices until crisp; rub warm toast with a cut clove of raw garlic.
Spoon the fresh tomato topping generously over each toast and serve immediately.

substitutions.coriander: Fresh basil, parsley, or dried oregano

name: Paneer Bhurji (Spiced Scramble)
description: Savory crumbled cottage cheese sauteed with spiced onions, tomatoes, and warm turmeric.
steps: Crumble paneer with your fingers into small curds.
Heat oil, crackle cumin seeds, and saute diced onion and green chili until translucent.
Add diced tomato, turmeric, and salt; cook 3 minutes until soft.
Fold in crumbled paneer, toss gently for 2 minutes so it stays moist, and serve with bread or roti.

name: Savory Oatmeal Bowl
description: Umami-rich congee-style oats topped with a jammy egg, wilted spinach, and soy drizzle.
steps: Simmer oats in salted water for 5 minutes until creamy; stir in spinach during the final minute.
Fry an egg in a small pan with a drop of oil and sliced garlic until edges are crisp.
Top the warm oats with the fried egg, garlic chips, and a drizzle of soy sauce.

name: Classic French Toast
description: Custardy, golden pan-fried bread slices with crisp caramelized edges.
steps: Whisk eggs, milk, sugar, and a pinch of salt in a shallow dish.
Dip bread slices briefly on both sides so they absorb custard without getting soggy.
Cook in a buttered skillet over medium heat for 2–3 minutes per side until golden brown.

substitutions.milk: Water + splash of cream or plant milk

name: Tuna & Corn Mayo Melt
description: Toasted open-faced or closed sandwich loaded with creamy sweetcorn tuna salad and melted cheese.
steps: Drain canned tuna and mix with sweetcorn, mayonnaise, finely diced onion, and a pinch of salt.
Pile onto bread slices and top with grated cheese.
Toast in a covered skillet or broiler for 4 minutes until bread is crisp and cheese bubbles.

name: 3-Ingredient Peanut Butter Cookies
description: Chewy, rich flourless peanut butter cookies mixed in one bowl in 2 minutes.
steps: Preheat oven to 175°C (350°F) and line a baking tray.
Stir peanut butter, sugar, egg, and salt together until a thick uniform dough forms.
Roll into 12 balls, flatten with a fork in a criss-cross pattern, and bake 10–12 minutes.

substitutions.peanut butter: Almond butter or sunflower seed butter

name: Lemon Rice (Chitranna)
description: Bright, tangy golden rice tossed with crunchy roasted peanuts, cumin, and fresh lemon juice.
steps: Heat oil in a pan and roast peanuts until crunchy; add cumin seeds and chopped chili.
Lower heat, stir in turmeric, salt, and cooked rice; toss gently until coated in golden color.
Turn off heat, squeeze fresh lemon juice over the rice, toss once more, and serve.

name: Creamy Mushroom Toast
description: Golden pan-seared mushrooms simmered in a rich garlic-cream glaze over crunchy toast.
steps: Slice mushrooms and saute in butter over medium-high heat until browned and moisture evaporates.
Add minced garlic and salt; cook 1 minute, then pour in milk and simmer 2 minutes until thick.
Spoon over crisp toasted bread and serve immediately.

substitutions.milk: Cream, sour cream, or a spoonful of cream cheese

name: Quick Veg Pulao
description: Fragrant one-pot spiced rice cooked with sweet carrots, green peas, and caramelized onions.
steps: Rinse rice and soak for 10 minutes while dicing onion and carrot.
Heat oil in a pot, crackle cumin seeds, and saute onion, carrot, and peas for 3 minutes.
Add drained rice, turmeric, salt, and 2 cups water; bring to a boil, cover, and simmer on low for 12 minutes.
Rest covered 5 minutes, fluff with a fork, and serve.

name: Egg Drop Soup
description: Silky 10-minute comfort broth swirled with delicate golden egg ribbons and sweetcorn.
steps: Bring water, smashed garlic, soy sauce, sweetcorn, and salt to a gentle boil.
Lower heat to a simmer and slowly drizzle beaten eggs in a thin stream while stirring gently.
Turn off heat, top with sliced spring onions, and serve hot.

name: Caprese Melted Toast
description: Crisp open-faced garlic toast layered with juicy tomato slices and bubbly melted cheese.
steps: Brush bread with oil and toast lightly in a skillet; rub with a cut clove of garlic.
Top with sliced tomato, a pinch of salt, and shredded cheese.
Cover the skillet for 2–3 minutes on low heat until the cheese melts completely.

name: Spicy Garlic Potato Wedges
description: Crispy oven-baked or skillet-roasted potato wedges tossed in aromatic garlic-chili oil.
steps: Cut washed potatoes into thick wedges and pat dry.
Toss with oil, minced garlic, finely chopped chili, and salt.
Roast at 210°C (410°F) for 22 minutes (or pan-fry covered then uncovered) until crisp and golden.

name: Yogurt Berry & Oat Parfait
description: Zero-cook creamy breakfast or late-night study bowl layered with oats, sliced banana, and honey.
steps: Spoon half the yogurt into a bowl or jar and layer with oats and sliced banana.
Repeat layers and drizzle honey over the top.
Enjoy immediately for crunch or chill 15 minutes for soft overnight-style oats.

name: Egg & Cheese Breakfast Wrap
description: Warm griddled wrap stuffed with fluffy scrambled eggs, wilted spinach, and melted cheese.
steps: Scramble beaten eggs with salt and spinach in butter until soft and set.
Warm tortillas, layer eggs and cheese in the center, and roll tightly.
Sear seam-side down in the skillet for 1 minute to seal and crisp.

name: Tomato Rice (Thakkali Sadam)
description: Tangy, spiced South Indian tomato-onion rice made in minutes with leftover cooked rice.
steps: Heat oil, crackle cumin seeds, and saute sliced onion and minced garlic until golden.
Add chopped tomatoes, turmeric, and salt; cook 5 minutes until jammy.
Fold in cooked rice and toss over medium heat for 3 minutes until well combined.

name: Cabbage & Carrot Stir-Fry
description: Crisp-tender shredded cabbage and carrots flash-seared with garlic and savory soy glaze.
steps: Thinly shred cabbage and julienne carrot.
Heat oil over high heat, sizzle minced garlic for 20 seconds, then toss in vegetables.
Stir-fry 4–5 minutes until crisp-tender, splash with soy sauce and salt, and serve.

name: Cheesy Garlic Bread
description: Golden, buttery garlic toast blanketed in bubbly melted cheese.
steps: Mix softened butter with finely minced garlic and a pinch of salt.
Spread garlic butter onto bread slices and top generously with shredded cheese.
Toast in a covered skillet on low heat for 4 minutes (or bake at 200°C for 6 minutes) until melted.

name: Bean & Tomato Chili Bowl
description: Hearty 20-minute stovetop bean chili simmered with tomatoes, cumin, and gentle heat.
steps: Saute diced onion, garlic, and chopped chili in oil for 4 minutes.
Add cumin, diced tomatoes, drained beans, salt, and 1/2 cup water.
Simmer 12 minutes until thick and rich; serve over rice or with toast.

name: Sweet Banana Fry (Pazham Pori Style)
description: Caramelized pan-seared banana slices with golden crisp edges — ready in 7 minutes.
steps: Slice ripe-but-firm bananas lengthwise or into thick coins.
Melt butter in a nonstick pan, sprinkle sugar and a tiny pinch of salt, and lay bananas flat.
Sear 2 minutes per side until deeply caramelized and golden.

name: Egg & Potato Hash
description: Crispy skillet-fried diced potatoes, onions, and peppers topped with sunny-side eggs.
steps: Dice potatoes into small 1cm cubes and fry in oil with salt for 10 minutes until golden.
Add diced onion and bell pepper; saute 4 minutes until tender.
Make two wells, crack in the eggs, cover, and cook 3–4 minutes until whites set.

name: Cucumber & Yogurt Raita Bowl
description: Refreshing chilled cucumber-yogurt side or light dip seasoned with roasted cumin and herbs.
steps: Whisk yogurt until smooth and season with salt and cumin.
Fold in grated or finely diced cucumber and chopped coriander.
Serve chilled alongside any rice dish, dal, or spicy flatbread.

name: Simple Marinara Pasta
description: Classic homestyle pasta tossed in a fresh slow-simmered garlic-tomato marinara sauce.
steps: Boil pasta in salted water until al dente, saving 1/4 cup pasta water.
Saute finely diced onion and garlic in oil until fragrant, then add chopped tomatoes and salt.
Simmer 10 minutes until saucy, toss in pasta with reserved cooking water, and serve.
